PREFIX brick: <http://brick.schema.org/>
PREFIX ref: <https://brick.schema.org/ontology/v1/ref#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?zone ?setpoint ?point ?ts ?name WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone .
  ?zone rdfs:label ?name .
  FILTER (CONTAINS(?name, "Perimeter_mid_ZN_4"))
  ?zone ?sp ?setpoint .
  ?setpoint ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts .
}

PREFIX brick: <http://brick.schema.org/>
PREFIX ref: <https://brick.schema.org/ontology/v1/ref#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?zone ?name ?point ?ts ?pcl WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone .
  ?zone rdfs:label ?name .
  FILTER (CONTAINS(?name, "Perimeter_mid_ZN_4"))
  ?point brick:isPartOf ?zone .
  ?point ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts .
  OPTIONAL { ?point rdf:type ?pcl }
}
